function.arguments: {"index": 4, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The question asks for the mean age of customers in the sales data. The data includes QA orders (revenue = 999999.99), which are explicitly documented as internal test orders and not real customers. These must be excluded. Refunded orders are real customers who completed a purchase and later returned it; their age is valid and should be included. Missing age (customer_age = -1) is a documented sentinel for missing data and must be excluded. Therefore, we exclude only QA orders and missing age, and include all other rows — including refunded orders — as valid customers in the data. The mean age is computed on this valid set."}
